prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1340; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: This is the adjuster recording a statement regarding the parking lot collision in Katy, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give you my first name for now, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving slowly through the lot of a shopping center, looking for an open space near the entrance. It was busy, with cars backing out all over the place.

Q: What happened next?

A: A silver sedan backed out from a space on my left and didn't stop. I hit the brakes hard, but the front of my car clipped the rear quarter panel of theirs. It wasn't a high-speed impact, but it was enough to throw me against the steering wheel and jerk my arms.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: My right wrist hurt right away, and I was sore in the shoulder. I didn't think much of it until the next morning, when the wrist was swollen and I couldn't grip anything.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic, and they took X-rays. The doctor told me the wrist was fractured and put me in a splint. I'm scheduled to see an orthopedic specialist for follow-up.

Q: Did you get the other driver's information?

A: Yes, I exchanged insurance details and took a few photos of both vehicles before we moved them.

Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?

A: Not that I can think of. I just want to get my car repaired and get my wrist healed so I can get back to work.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
